mentions.name: Tweaks
mentions.description: An inline editing feature called Tweaks for the jar.tools class decompiler that lets users modify compiled Java class files without decompilation — changing values such as numbers, strings, and access modifiers directly in the bytecode without needing to recompile the .class file.
mentions.problem: Updating values in compiled Java classes normally requires decompiling and recompiling the .class file.
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding Java class inline editing without decompilation feature to https://jar.tools/class-decompiler - so you can update some class values (number or strings, or event access modifiers) without needing to recompile the .class file. I called it Tweaks
